node.title: Primitive shift-pair Haar norm-product gate
node.statement: The dyadic folds of every balanced signed shift-pair vector satisfy the exact shared Haar identity sum_j E_j/2^(j+1)=2e. For any nonempty set S of prefix-supplied nonzero folds, if a_j=N/2^(j+2), A_S=sum a_j, R_S=sum ord_nj(p)o_j, and M_S=sum M_j, then p^M_S<=p^R_S<=product_j |Norm(beta_j)|<=product_j E_j^a_j<=(eN/A_S)^A_S. Thus the exact integer inequality p^R_S A_S^A_S<=(eN)^A_S is necessary. Coefficient primitivity makes scale zero active, and an exact difference-degree cell supplies depth T=e-d-1. This is a pattern-exclusion gate, not a population bound.
